benchmark.result_aggregation: Equal-weight sequence means; p95 fields are means of sequence P95, not pooled percentiles
benchmark.review_note: Frozen test subjects and observations. One dimension-learning regression found in code review was fixed; the same test was rerun as regression, not claimed as new independent data.

calibration.limitation: Empirical block calibration; shared procedural motion/subjects violate independent real-world exchangeability.

rgb_regression.reason: Mean proxy error and G1 reference admission regressed; maximum error and coverage improved.

serial.limitation: Real exposure and synchronization require SDK clock mapping; replay measures actual computation and scheduling only.

concurrent_detector.limitation: Real exposure and synchronization require SDK clock mapping; replay measures actual computation and scheduling only.

detector_concurrency_parity.scope: same hybrid model; body remains batch 1; four concurrent detector calls only

source.frame_alignment: published demo frame indices; hardware exposure skew unverified
source.purpose: real RGB multi-person rejection and occlusion challenge; not quantitative 3D accuracy

public_real_rgb.outcome: All views rejected due to multiple people; current source identity association is incomplete.

tests.initial_vision_process_note: One native process ended without a completed unittest summary; subsequent verbose full run passed. Cause not established.

limitations: Procedural observation benchmark bypasses RGB detectors; fixed noise/swap schedules do not represent every real failure.
Different body configurations are synthetic, not independent real participants; contact reference is kinematic, not force-based.
Foot sliding did not improve; contact and rotations are geometric estimates without real-world calibration.
Discrete lag resolution is about 33 ms; a zero-frame estimate is not zero end-to-end latency.
No learned cross-view feature network, SMPL-X/MHR fit, multi-person identity tracker or OOD network was reproduced.
Global left/right symmetry and anatomical axial twist remain unresolved; partial outputs are explicitly unknown.
Empirical uncertainty uses correlated synthetic sequences and is deliberately forbidden for RGB/live hardware.
PerceptionGate supplies planner requests only; blending, balance and full G1 dynamic control remain unvalidated.

cleanup.tool_reason: blocked by policy; no detailed reason supplied
